categories.main_business_segments: Supreme Electronics Co., Ltd. primarily operates as a professional semiconductor electronic components distributor. Its main business includes the agency and sales of semiconductor components such as memory products (DRAM, SSD, eMMC), system LSI products (Display IC, Image Sensor, Power IC), LED products, and electronic materials. The company also engages in international trade, logistics, and provides technical support and integrated solutions to customers in various electronic product sectors.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced semiconductor technologies through its agency partnerships with leading manufacturers like Samsung. It focuses on technical service support, product integration, and design-in solutions to assist customers in product development and reduce time-to-market. The company also invests in R&D for new applications including health screening systems, electric vehicle battery packs, and energy management systems, supported by ISO-13485 certification for medical products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Supreme Electronics serves a broad customer base including manufacturers in the information technology, communications, consumer electronics, automotive, and medical device industries. Key markets include PC, mobile devices, servers, cloud computing, automotive semiconductors, and emerging fields such as AI, IoT, and electric vehicles. Major customers are located in Taiwan, China, Hong Kong, Southeast Asia, and the United States.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across the Asia-Pacific region with headquarters in Taipei, Taiwan, and subsidiaries or offices in Hong Kong, Shanghai, Singapore, South Korea, and other locations. Its sales and logistics network covers Taiwan, Greater China (including mainland China and Hong Kong), Southeast Asia, and the United States, focusing on servicing customers in these key electronics manufacturing hubs.
categories.supply_chain_position: Supreme Electronics functions as a midstream semiconductor components distributor within the supply chain. It acts as an intermediary between upstream semiconductor manufacturers and downstream electronic product manufacturers, providing procurement, inventory management, technical support, and integrated solutions to facilitate efficient supply and demand matching.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes expanding its product portfolio with niche and high-value products to sustain growth and profitability. R&D efforts focus on technical support services, new product applications in health technology, electric vehicle batteries, and energy solutions. It also prioritizes talent development, operational efficiency, and sustainability initiatives including carbon footprint reduction and corporate social responsibility.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of semiconductor components and electronic materials. The company operates on a buy-and-sell model, purchasing components from manufacturers and selling to downstream customers. Additional revenue streams include technical service support, integrated solution offerings, and logistics services.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: Supreme Electronics is one of the leading semiconductor component distributors in Taiwan with a broad product range and strong partnerships, notably with Samsung. It competes with other regional and global semiconductor distributors by leveraging its extensive product portfolio, technical support capabilities, and regional logistics network. The company aims to strengthen its market position in Greater China and Southeast Asia through expansion and enhanced service offerings.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2022, the company reported consolidated revenues of approximately NT$174 billion, a decrease of 16.61% from the previous year, reflecting market downturns in consumer electronics. Net profit attributable to the parent company was about NT$2.2 billion with earnings per share of NT$5.16. The company has a strong asset base with total assets around NT$45.5 billion and equity of NT$13.8 billion. It has demonstrated steady growth over the years with strategic capital increases and maintains a robust financial structure despite market volatility.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Supreme Electronics offers customers a comprehensive one-stop solution with a wide range of semiconductor and electronic components, reducing procurement complexity and inventory risks. Its strong technical support and design-in services help customers accelerate product development and improve competitiveness. The company’s stable agency rights with leading manufacturers, extensive regional presence, and commitment to sustainability and corporate governance further differentiate it in the competitive semiconductor distribution market.
